title: 7 Trucks That Were Total Flops (And the Mistake That Killed Each One)
description:
A luxury pickup that cost fifty-two thousand dollars, and you could not get it with four-wheel drive. A truck that Tesla says it can build at more than one hundred twenty-five thousand a year, and Americans bought about twenty thousand. An electric Ram that was cancelled before a single customer got one. These are the trucks that flopped, and every one of them failed for a reason you can learn from.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]
